description: This Java source file defines the class TestRunParameters, which implements a configuration editor for Android test run settings within an IDE environment. It manages UI components for selecting test parameters such as package, class, method, and runner, and handles user interactions for browsing and setting these options.

classes.name: TestRunParameters
classes.description: A configuration editor class for setting up Android test run parameters, including UI components and browsing logic.

methods.name: addTestingType
methods.description: Associates a radio button with a specific test type and adds an action listener to update UI components accordingly.

methods.name: getTestingType
methods.description: Returns the currently selected test type based on the radio buttons.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies the current UI selections to the given AndroidTestRunConfiguration object.

methods.name: resetFrom
methods.description: Resets the UI components based on the provided AndroidTestRunConfiguration object.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component (panel) of this editor.
